A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the mechanisms involved in endothelium-dependent hyperpolarization are not the same in all arteries and that the contribution of EETs is not necessarily reduced in hypertension.

The main takeaway from our work is that
EDHF is not a single factor, but rather a complex mechanism involving multiple factors that are regulated in different ways in hypertension and in response to antihypertensive treatment.
EDHF is mediated by different mechanisms in WKY rats and spontaneously hypertensive rats.
